en: Maatrubhumi: May War Rest in Peace

plotEn:
Maatrubhumi: May War Rest in Peace is an upcoming Indian Hindi-language war film directed by Apoorva Lakhia and produced by Salman Khan under Salman Khan Films banner. The film stars Salman Khan in the lead role, alongside Chitrangada Singh, Anoop Bikram Shahi and Prashant Tamang in his final film appearance.
